n/call-a-tool.md): Executes a tool on the server and returns the MCP `CallToolResult` plus an additive `durationMs` (wall-clock ti
me of `executeTool`). Tool-level failures (`isError: true` in the result) are **successful calls** — the server answered; only tra
nsport/auth errors use the error envelope.\n- [Render a prompt](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/render-a-prompt.md
): Renders a prompt with arguments and returns the MCP `GetPromptResult` directly (`description?`, `messages`).\n- [Render an MCP
App widget headlessly](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/render-an-mcp-app-widget-headlessly.md): Call an MCP App to
ol and mount its `ui://` widget in real headless Chromium running the production host bridge, then report whether it rendered, wha
t it logged, what it was blocked from fetching, and the widget as an accessibility tree with addressable elements.\n- [Create a re
tained widget session](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/create-a-retained-widget-session.md): Available only on the
local Inspector that created the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires a verified user or API key. A session is bound
to the original subject, project and server and expires after its idle timeout. Executes the tool and retains its App in one local
Chromium context.…\n- [Read a retained widget snapshot](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/read-a-retained-widget-sn
apshot.md): Available only on the local Inspector that created the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires a verified use
r or API key. A session is bound to the original subject, project and server and expires after its idle timeout. Returns an access
ibility tree and addressable elements without replay…\n- [Act on a retained widget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/executio
n/act-on-a-retained-widget.md): Available only on the local Inspector that created the session; hosted deployments return 404. Req
uires a verified user or API key. A session is bound to the original subject, project and server and expires after its idle timeou
t. Runs one coordinate action with fresh project/server authorization.\n- [Run a retained widget step](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api
-reference/execution/run-a-retained-widget-step.md): Available only on the local Inspector that created the session; hosted deploy
ments return 404. Requires a verified user or API key. A session is bound to the original subject, project and server and expires
after its idle timeout. Runs one semantic action or assertion, using the same locator vocabul…\n- [Close a retained widget session
](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/close-a-retained-widget-session.md): Available only on the local Inspector that
created the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires a verified user or API key. A session is bound to the original subjec
t, project and server and expires after its idle timeout. Disposes the original owner's browser. Returns closed=false if no mat…\n
- [List a suite's settings history](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-suites/list-a-suites-settings-history.md): One entr
y per committed edit to the suite's settings, newest first: who made it, which STORED fields moved, the note they left, how many r
uns were launched against it, and the revision group that ties one request's writes together. Rows carry no configuration snapshot
s. Send a `revisionNumber` back…\n- [Attach one environment to a suite (atomic append)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval
-suites/attach-one-environment-to-a-suite-atomic-append.md): APPEND one project environment to the suite's attachments, if it is n
ot already there.\n- [List a server's accounts](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/list-a-servers-accounts.md):
The accounts this server signs in with that you can see: your own personal accounts, or, on a server shared with the project, its
project accounts. Another member's personal account never appears. METADATA ONLY: no account response carries a token.\n- [Get a
server account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/get-a-server-account.md): One account, by id or name. Anothe
r member's personal account answers `404`, the same as a missing one. A name two accounts share answers `409` with `details.code:
\"account_name_ambiguous\"` and both ids in `details.accountIds`.\n- [Upload tokens to a server account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/a
pi-reference/server-accounts/upload-tokens-to-a-server-account.md): Creates the account (`201`) or replaces its token in place (`2
00`, same id). A well-formed account id never creates one: an unknown id is `404`. Any other reference is a name, and a name no ac
count has creates the account.\n- [Delete a server account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/delete-a-server-
account.md): Deletes the account and its stored token. The token's issuer is asked to revoke it where the issuer supports revocati
on (best effort), which also invalidates any copy of the same token you hold.\n- [Rename a server account or make it the default](
https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/rename-a-server-account-or-make-it-the-default.md): Rename the account, make
it the default, or both; a rename applies first. A name another account on the server uses answers `409` with `details.code: \"ac
count_name_taken\"`.\n- [Import OAuth tokens](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/oauth/import-oauth-tokens.md): **Deprecated.**
Use `PUT /projects/{projectId}/servers/{serverId}/accounts/{account}`. This route uploads to your default account on the server,
creating an unnamed one when the server has none, and is removed 90 days after the accounts API shipped. Every answer carries `Dep
recation: true`, a `Sunse…\n- [List GitHub Checks repositories](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/list-github-checks-rep
ositories.md): The repositories in this organization whose pull requests run an eval suite, plus the repositories the MCPJam GitHu
b App can reach (the choices a connect has).\n- [Run an eval suite on a repository's pull requests](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-re
ference/evals/run-an-eval-suite-on-a-repositorys-pull-requests.md): Connect a repository so every pull request to it runs one eval
suite and reports a GitHub check. **Affects everyone who opens a pull request on that repository**, and with `outagePolicy: fail_
closed` it can block their merges.\n- [Request insights for an eval run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/request-insig
hts-for-an-eval-run.md): **No credits are consumed** — the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the finished run and draws o
n the same shared `insightsPerDay` request ledger as swarm and user-testing insights.\n- [Grade an eval run with LLM as Judge](htt
ps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/grade-an-eval-run-with-llm-as-judge.md): **Spends.** Runs the goal-completion judge over
the finished run, scoring each case's final answer against its expected output.\n- [Create a project](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-
reference/projects/create-a-project.md): Creates a project in the caller's organization and responds `201` with its detail. Requir
es organization membership and counts against the plan's `maxProjects` limit. Guest callers are denied.\n- [Delete a project and e
verything scoped to it](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/projects/delete-a-project-and-everything-scoped-to-it.md): IRREVERSI
BLE, and it cascades: project access grants and invites, the mapped workspace and its memberships, every saved server in the proje
ct (each soft-deleted asynchronously, which also rotates the host configs that referenced it), and hosted tasks. Requires project
admin. The request body must be…\n- [Update project metadata](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/projects/update-project-metada
ta.md): Updates name, description, icon or visibility. Requires project admin; a non-member gets `404` rather than `403`, so the r
esponse never confirms that a project exists. The project's server map is not updatable here — see the per-server routes.\n- [What
the caller may do here](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/projects/what-the-caller-may-do-here.md): Role, gate state, plan li
mits and a set of derived booleans — so an agent on a static surface can check before it acts instead of attempting a write and re
ading the failure.\n- [Save a server into a project](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/save-a-server-into-a-project.md
